text:
Maya: Quick flag 1: observed persistent NVLink P2P chatter on shared-shelf-usw2-2 during bursts from two tenants. 95p token latency +130ms. Window: 2026-03-30 09:14 UTC. :warning:
Ibrahim: Which tenants and request shapes? Could be warmup.
Maya: t-orion and t-vela. Lots of tiny parallel streams (seq < 50) and very high KV fetch rates. NVLink TX/RX hovering ~88-93%.
Sofia: If it's inter-GPU NVLink traffic, simple rack migration won't help. We should try a reversible egress cap and a runtime model fallback to reduce KV chattiness.
Sanjay: Agree. Short plan: (1) dry-run detection in prod for 48h (no enforcement) -> measure FP rate; (2) if signal stable, run soft-throttle (token-bucket policer) + reduce KV TTL for 60s; (3) if persistent >10m schedule ephemeral dedicated carveout.
Maya: I tested soft-throttle in staging. Command we used:
```
# apply soft egress policer
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/tenants/t-orion/actions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS" \
  -d '{"action":"police","egress_tps":180,"burst":360,"duration_s":45,"reason":"nvlink_p2p_probe"}'
```
Maya: Staging result: NVLink util fell to ~55% and 95p latency returned close to baseline. No client errors during the 45s window.
Ibrahim: What's the cost for ephemeral carveout? Different from other threads: our quote for a prewarmed 8x-A100 is ~$620/day (includes prewarm/egress reservation). We can offer a 3-day trial credit.
Sofia: Also propose adding tenant metadata field `egress_bandwidth_profile` (low/medium/high) to prefer dedicated capacity during provisioning and to inform routing decisions. Surface in billing UI for sales/CS.
Sanjay: For automation: noise-detector rule suggestion -> if nvlink_peer_util > 0.8 && tenant_kv_fetch_rate > 0.6 for 90s -> emit event (dry-run). After 48h dry-run, if repeat offenders, enable auto-tag + soft-police behind feature flag.
Maya: Quick Prom rule for dry-run:
```
- alert: NVLinkP2PChatter
  expr: avg_over_time(nvlink_peer_util[2m]) > 0.8 and avg_over_time(tenant_kv_fetch_rate[2m]) > 0.6
  for: 90s
  labels: { severity: warning }
```
Ibrahim: Please record audit metadata for any auto-actions: trigger_ts, metric_values, action_id, operator. CS/legal will require traces if customers notice degraded QoS.
Sofia: Also add a runtime routing fallback: if tenant_tag=egress_heavy -> prefer `gen-compact` model variant with lower KV footprint. We'll measure quality delta post-migration.
ops-bot: Incident INC-20260330-11 created and paged oncall. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/nvlink-p2p-mitigation
Maya: Action items:
- Maya: start 48h dry-run in prod (ETA: now)
- Sanjay: PR to noise-detector to add labeling hooks & soft-police executor behind FF (ETA: EOD)
- Ibrahim: confirm finance quote and draft trial credit terms (ETA: tomorrow)
- Sofia: spec `egress_bandwidth_profile` field and routing fallback (ETA: 48h)
Maya: We'll reconvene in #eng-infra after dry-run summary. :eyes:
